title: Episode 6
summary: A woman arrives on the island to meet a man she met online. He video-calls her at the airport, appearing to be talking to an intruder. They later find him shot dead.
method: The victim had staged the video call using pre-recorded audio to give the impression that there was an intruder. His intention was to scam the woman out of money. However, the killer committed the crime while the woman was cautiously walking through the house. The victim had a bullet in his hand because he wanted to demonstrate to the woman the real danger he was in. The real bullet was removed by the killer.
motive: The killer didn't like how the victim scammed women out of their money, for the sake of his granddaughter and he felt sorry for the victims. He didn't want these scams to continue so he had to kill the victim.
killer: The taxi driver, who worked with the victim on these scams
